destination.description: A descriptive text to describe the destination of the live streaming.

streamUrl.description: The URL to view the live streaming, i.e. the playback URL.

layoutWithoutSharedContent.description:
Live streaming layout when there's no shared content.
 * `grid` - The video layout that allows you to see multiple participants in a meeting in grids.
 * `stack` - The video layout that displays the active speaker on the stage and up to six participants in thumbnails across the top.
 * `focus` - The video layout that only displays the active speaker.

layoutWithSharedContent.description:
Live streaming layout when there's shared content.
 * `stack` - The video layout that displays the shared content on the stage and up to six participants in thumbnails across the top.
 * `focusedContentWithActiveSpeaker` - The layout that displays the shared content in the main part of the screen and a large thumbnail of the active speaker in the upper right corner.
 * `focusedContent` - The layout that only displays the shared content in the main part of the screen and does not display the participants.

allowChangeLayoutInMeeting.description: Whether or not to allow change the live streaming layout in the meeitng.

followStageLayoutWhenSynced.description: Whether or not to follow the stage layout when it's being synchronized.
